services.name: Guided Heli-Fishing
services.desc: A Unique Heli-Fishing Adventure in BC Overview The ultimate small group heli-fishing experience. Officially known as Winslow Lake, this small, emerald-green lake is home to countless hungry Cutthroat Trout, and the occasional lunker Bull Trout. Enjoy the tranquility of this hidden paradise with your friends, family, or co-workers. Dig your feet in the white sand and cast from shore or hop in one of our inflatable angler kayaks. Appreciate the rugged landscapes that surround the lake and enjoy this once-in-a-lifetime heli-fishing experience. Keep an eye on the shoreline as there is a good 5 Hours • Once in a lifetime heli-fishing experience! • Trout fishing available April to October

services.name: Crater Lake Kayaking
services.desc: This is a unique volcano paddling trip unlike anywhere else in BC. As the name implies, these lakes are on the flank of a small Tuya (subglacial) Volcano. It’s considered to be the Southernmost volcano in the Garibaldi belt. Don’t worry, it’s extinct. There is abundant vegetation and wildflowers all around this beautiful deep blue lake. Roam the crater rim while admiring the lava rock that cooled against glacier ice thousands of years ago. Paddle an inflatable kayak on one of the 5 lakes in the vicinity, including one set within the crater. All these experiences 5 hours • Guided Kayaking at One of Five Volcanic Lakes • June to October

services.name: Elopements and Engagements
services.desc: Say it at the summit. Contact us today to plan your perfect wilderness elopement or proposal. Bring your own officiant and photographer or let us supply them for you We are the only operator in British Columbia with tenured crown land approved for wilderness elopements and engagements. Choose an epic location from one of five lakes, a glacier, beautiful alpine ridges, or a volcano! All these experiences are private, and guests enjoy exclusive use of the helicopter. Just you and up to three adventure friends. For custom unforgettable backcountry adventures, Custom mountain top weddings and engagements • Year round!

services.name: Golden Ears Provincial Park Sightseeing
services.desc: Golden Ears Provincial Park Tour 1 Hour Overview This trip departs from Fort Langley Airport and soars over Alouette lake, past the Golden Ears group of peaks (Edge Peak and Blanshard Peak) before continuing up Gold Creek towards Mount Robie Reid and Mount Judge Howay, the two tallest mountains in the park. Take in the spectacular views of the park, admiring the sprawling landscape of temperate rainforests and mountain vistas before returning to base. The tour includes 1 hour of flight time and unparalleled views of Golden Ears Provincial Park. All of these experiences are private, 1 hour • Beautiful Mountain Landscapes! • Great photo opportunities!

services.name: Vancouver Sightseeing
services.desc: Tour 1 Hour Overview See Vancouver and the North Shore Mountains like never before on this 1 hour sightseeing experience. Incredible views can be had immediately after take off from our base in Fort Langley. During your flight you’ll see Fort Langley, Pitt Meadows, Coquitlam, Deep Cove, Indian Arm, the downtown core, False Creek, Stanley Park, West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Cypress Mountain, Grouse Mountain, Seymour Mountain and much more! This experience can be enjoyed year round. Please dress appropriately for the weather conditions. All of these experiences 1 Hour • Amazing Aerial City Views • Great photo opportunities!

includes: The tour includes 1 hour of flight time and unparalleled views of Golden Ears Provincial Park.
